question: What was the primary focus of the Antyodaya Program launched in 1977?

options.text: Uplift the poorest sections of society

solution:
The correct answer is __**Uplift the poorest sections of society**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **Antyodaya Program** was launched in **1977** by the **Janata Party** government at the **Centre**. It was a landmark initiative in the history of **poverty alleviation** in **India**.

• The primary focus of the program was to **uplift the poorest sections of society**, specifically targeting those at the absolute bottom of the economic ladder, often referred to as the **poorest of the poor**.

• The scheme was first introduced in the state of **Rajasthan** on **October 2, 1977**, under the leadership of Chief Minister **Bhairon Singh Shekhawat**.

• The core strategy involved identifying the **five poorest families** in each village through the **Gram Sabha** and providing them with economic assistance to help them cross the **poverty line**.
